theme_strategy.archetype: Hybrid: Archetype 4 (Swiss/High Contrast) + Archetype 5 (Luxury / Gulf Corporate)
theme_strategy.design_philosophy: Gulf-corporate sophistication meets football energy. A highly professional, prestigious interface blending fintech-level data density (for dashboards/admin) with sports excitement. Relies on progressive disclosure, modular 'Bento' grids, and strict F-pattern information hierarchy.

rules: Avoid Inter, Roboto, and generic defaults.
Headings must use tight tracking. Overlines must use wide tracking.
Limit hero text size to text-5xl (fluid). Do not exceed.
Ensure proper font weight matching between English (Latin) and Arabic scripts.

primary.description: Deep Emerald Green - Corporate trust and football pitches.

accent.description: Royal Gold - Prestige, awards, desert sand.

grid_modes.employee_dashboard: Bento Grid - Asymmetrical but structured. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with varied spans (e.g., col-span-8 for Hero/Matches, col-span-4 for Leaderboard).
grid_modes.admin_portal: Control Room Grid - Dense and symmetrical. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for KPI summaries, full width for data tables.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous interior padding: p-6 or p-8 for cards to prevent text collision. Gaps: gap-6 to gap-8.
layout_and_spacing.bilingual_rtl_ltr_strategy: CRITICAL: Use Tailwind logical properties exclusively (ps-*, pe-*, ms-*, me-*, text-start, text-end, rounded-s-*, rounded-e-*). Set <html dir='rtl'> or <html dir='ltr'> dynamically. Never hardcode 'left' or 'right' margins/paddings.

components.surfaces: Neumorphic/Flat blend. Flat background with a crisp 1px border (border-border). No heavy static shadows.
components.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' strictly for sticky headers/nav (backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/80 border-b border-border).
components.buttons: Explicit hover states (hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md transition-all). Primary button uses Emerald, Secondary uses Outline. Accent buttons (Gold) for 'Predict Now' or high-value CTAs.
components.cards: Subtle border-radius (rounded-xl). Do not overuse cards; consider open grids for news/content.
components.tables: Shadcn based. High density, distinct header row, zebra-striping optional but preferred for large admin datasets.

image_urls.description: Dramatic illuminated stadium night. Use with heavy Emerald gradient overlay (bg-emerald-900/80) for the login page hero.
High-angle stadium view. Excellent for dashboard headers or news section featured image.
Premium gold trophies close-up. Use in the Awards/Prizes section.
Modern corporate office team meeting. Use for generic placeholder avatars, admin dashboard background, or internal announcements.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='predict-match-button', data-testid='admin-users-tab').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over the Emerald primary color or dark overlays meets 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimums (use white text).
testing_and_accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Animations should be swift (max 200ms) and purposeful.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not use AI-slop purple/teal gradients. Adhere strictly to the Emerald and Gold palette.
2. Implement a context/provider for RTL/LTR switching that changes the dir attribute on the root HTML element and swaps the font family CSS variables.

3. Use Tailwind CSS logical properties (e.g., `ps-4`, `me-2`, `text-start`) instead of physical ones (`pl-4`, `mr-2`, `text-left`) across the ENTIRE application to ensure seamless bilingual RTL functionality.
4. Construct the Employee Dashboard using the 'Bento' grid concept, prioritizing the 'North Star' metric (User's Rank/Points) at the top start position.
5. Build the Admin Portal with high data density (fintech style), utilizing progressive disclosure for complex tables and analytics.
6. Customize Shadcn UI components natively in React (.js) using standard Tailwind classes matching this guideline.
7. Ensure EVERY button, form input, navigation link, and table row has a contextual `data-testid`.
